ambient: A bell goes somewhere below, and nobody comes out of anywhere.
Feet on the flight above yours, keeping your pace exactly.
The light on this landing is the light from the last one.
description: Stairs going up, in a stairwell that smells like a school. You have been climbing a while and you are not tired, which is how you know. The landings have doors, the doors have wired glass, and behind the glass it is always the same afternoon.
name: The Flight Up

looks: Through the wired glass: a corridor, a bin, the same afternoon.
Propped open with a chair, and the chair is the only new thing here.
You have come through this one. Recently. Going up.
objects.name: a landing door

looks: Worn smooth in the middle by a great many hands, none of them yours.
Cold, then warm where you have just held it, then cold again ahead of you.
It ends. The stairs do not.
objects.name: the handrail

weather: A cold draught comes down the stairwell from a floor that is above every floor.
